name: google-flow-runner
description: OPTIONAL local Playwright automation that drives the Google Flow (labs.google/flow) web UI to generate Step 5 AI video clips and import them back into AI Content Factory via its existing HTTP API. This does NOT replace the manual copy/paste + upload workflow, which remains the primary/fallback path. Never calls a paid API on the user's behalf - it drives the free labs.google/flow web UI with the user's own session/credits.
